properties.comment: PREDISPATCHLOAD shows pre-dispatch targets for each dispatchable unit, including additional fields to handle the Ancillary Services functionality. No record is written where a unit is not dispatched. PREDISPATCHLOAD shows all the results for each period.

fields.doc: Unique identifier of predispatch run in the form YYYYMMDDPP with 01 at 04:30
fields.name: PREDISPATCHSEQNO

fields.doc: SPD Predispatch run no, typically 1. It increments if the case is re-run.
fields.name: RUNNO

fields.doc: Dispatchable unit identifier for fast start
fields.name: DUID

fields.doc: PERIODID is just a period count, starting from 1 for each predispatch run. Use DATETIME to determine half hour period.
fields.name: PERIODID

fields.doc: Flag to indicate if this result set was sourced from the pricing run (INTERVENTION=0) or the physical run (INTERVENTION=1). In the event that there is not intervention in the market, both pricing and physical runs correspond to INTERVENTION=0
fields.name: INTERVENTION

fields.doc: Dispatch mode of unit for fast start (1-4)
fields.name: DISPATCHMODE

fields.doc: Initial MW at start of first period. For periods subsequent to the first period of a Pre-Dispatch run, this value represents the cleared target for the previous period of that Pre-Dispatch run. Negative values when Bi-directional Unit start from importing power, otherwise positive.
fields.name: INITIALMW

fields.doc: Target MW for end of period. Negative values when Bi-directional Unit is importing power, otherwise positive.
fields.name: TOTALCLEARED

fields.doc: Lower 5 min MW target in period
fields.name: LOWER5MIN

fields.doc: Lower 60 sec MW target in period
fields.name: LOWER60SEC

fields.name: LOWER6SEC

fields.name: RAISE6SEC

fields.name: RAMPDOWNRATE

fields.name: RAMPUPRATE
